Primary blocker is admin browser write calls failing with Invalid origin. Re-run full admin UI suite after that fix.
rca of the issue: Repro: login at /admin succeeds -> open /admin/upload or /admin/settings -> submit valid data -> UI error 'Invalid origin'. Backend endpoint protection in auth.admin() checks request Origin exact string equality against PUBLIC_URL. In deployed preview, runtime Origin normalization/proxy behavior differs enough to fail equality, so all protected non-GET admin actions are rejected with 403. Mitigation: parse and compare normalized scheme+hostname(+effective port) or use trusted-origin allowlist logic that tolerates default port normalization; preserve CSRF protection intent.
